verdict: A two-day paid outage cut lead volume; the intake pipeline needs immediate attention.
narrative: This period you received 80 leads at an average cost of $24.28 per lead, but the last week of that window was disrupted: August 6–7 recorded zero ad spend and zero leads across two consecutive days, which drove a 48% week-over-week drop in leads and pushed cost per lead up 37.64% compared to the prior week. The outage was confirmed on the paid side — website traffic held steady on those same days, ruling out any site issue. Ad delivery has been restored and we're monitoring closely to confirm stable spend resumes. Separately, a gap in the intake process means leads are not being moved into the follow-up pipeline, and closing that gap is the immediate priority this week.

average cost per lead this period, up from the prior week due to the two-day outage

watch_item.issue: 80 leads arrived this period but none have been moved into the follow-up pipeline — no opportunities created, no appointments set.
